title: Pont de Tolbiac
reviewProbeBasis: Current modeled road endpoints are asymmetric (-101.9/+96.6 m). Probe 0.5 m inside each endpoint and retain unmodified IGN ground values; upper road bank stations beyond the modeled endpoints are preserved separately in N0028-bank-profile.json.
attribution: IGN RGE ALTI, Licence Ouverte Etalab 2.0
method: Original official elevation service values on a metric world grid. No bridge fitting, channel carving, flattening or vertical conversion.
limitations: Query spacing is not a guarantee of source resolution or vertical accuracy. The service reports variable source-dependent accuracy.
RGE ALTI represents ground and modeled water surfaces, not bathymetry. Submerged foundation fitting requires separate evidence.
Historical model elevation datums must be compared with current bank surfaces and documentary references before approval.
